subject: Kickoff: C-Learning for goal-conditioned robotics sim
body:
Hi Jelena, Halima,

Kickoff for the C-Learning effort in agents-rl. The research reframes goal-conditioned RL as predicting and controlling the future state distribution of the agent, trained indirectly via a classifier that predicts whether an observation comes from the future. Two properties make this a product play for the robotics-sim offering:

1) The off-policy variant predicts the future state distribution of a NEW policy without collecting new experience - that's offline policy evaluation for customer robots, a straight cost saver.
2) The theory tells us how to choose the goal-sampling ratio, replacing the hand-tuned relabeling folklore our solutions team currently ships.

Milestones for Apr 27 - Jul 27: M1 (May 29) repro on the MuJoCo manipulation suite; M2 (early July) goal-sampling-ratio ablation + off-policy evaluation study; M3 (Jul 24) integration spec for the sim platform.

Halima is TL. Jelena owns staffing/compute - note MuJoCo licensing is handled at the org level already.

Ulla
